name: astral-finesse-cooldown|Astral Finesse cuts Astral Blade's cooldown by 4 sec (#3146)
contract: Astral Finesse 707636 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive 0x1c0) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectSpellClassMask word2 0x200000 and EffectBasePoints -4001, resolving to -4000 with DieSides 1, matching 'Reduces the cooldown of Astral Blade by $/1000;s1 sec'. Astral Blade 805563 has SpellFamilyFlags word2 0x200000 and RecoveryTime 20000 (no category cooldown), and no SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. Native path only: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN through Player::ApplySpellMod, and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits the modifier on the shared family and mask. The spell_modifier metric runs that same ApplySpellMod on the shipped 20000 ms: 20000 - 4000 = 16000. Sentinel Glaive 800506 (word2 0x20000000, RecoveryTime 15000) has a different mask and must stay at 15000; Astral Blade's duration (SPELLMOD_DURATION) must also stay 5000 because the talent only carries the cooldown op. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Astral Blade cooldown is unmodified without the talent
Astral Blade cooldown drops to 16 sec with the talent
Sentinel Glaive cooldown is not touched by the talent
Astral Blade duration is not touched by the talent
